# load

Measure CPU load of the machine using mpstat.

Waits until CPU utilization exceeds the `THRESH` threshold, then accumulates
load samples every second. When the script is terminated, outputs the average
CPU load (`RESULT-<PREFIX>CPUA`) and the per-core CPU ratio
(`RESULT-<PREFIX>CPUR`).

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut load NCPU=8 THRESH=30
```

Source: [`modules/load.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/load.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PREFIX` | *empty* | Prefix for result names, useful when importing multiple instances |
| `NCPU` | `16` | Number of CPU cores to monitor, from core 0 to NCPU-1 |
| `THRESH` | `50` | Minimum CPU utilization percentage before starting measurement |
